field.name: season_id
field.label: COM_DECARODCL_FIELD_SEASON
field.query: SELECT s.id AS value, CONCAT(t.name, ' — ', s.name, IF(s.season_year IS NULL, '', CONCAT(' (', s.season_year, ')'))) AS text FROM #__decarocompetitions_seasons AS s INNER JOIN #__decarocompetitions_tournaments AS t ON t.id = s.tournament_id WHERE s.state <> -2 AND t.state <> -2 ORDER BY s.season_year DESC, t.name ASC, s.name ASC

field.name: team_id
field.label: COM_DECARODCL_FIELD_TEAM
field.query: SELECT tm.id AS value, CONCAT(tm.name, ' — ', c.name, ' / ', f.name, ' [', tm.team_type, ']') AS text FROM #__decarocompetitions_teams AS tm INNER JOIN #__decarocompetitions_federations AS f ON f.id = tm.federation_id INNER JOIN #__decarocompetitions_countries AS c ON c.id = f.country_id WHERE tm.state <> -2 AND f.state <> -2 AND c.state <> -2 ORDER BY tm.name ASC
